people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “At the south side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
translations.bsb: On the south side, which will be 4,500 cubits long, there will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
translations.kjv: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
translations.asv: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
